mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decrease > 1% MoM does not correlate with weakening consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% MoM does not correlate with strengthening supply-side activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals strengthening demand and labor market improvement, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of HOUST increase & UNRATE decrease does not correlate with strengthening demand and labor market improvement.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the past month signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not correlate with labor market contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized < 2%).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of GDPC1 increase & CPIAUCSL annualized < 2% does not correlate with strong economic growth in low-inflation environments.
